environment: production Orithos UI with Playwright-intercepted replenishment and RFQ API fixtures
scope: UI request/response validation only; no Odoo supplier, RFQ, purchase, or chatter record was created

checks.name: RFQ review keeps the forecast snapshot with the buyer's edits
checks.evidence: Captured request included supplier, 21-day coverage, weighted-velocity method, suggestion, buyer-edited quantity, and reason.

checks.name: Removing a suggestion from the order preserves it in the audit
checks.evidence: A second line set to quantity 0 remained in the audit payload with its original suggestion and reason.

checks.name: Draft creation feedback reports the audit persistence result
checks.evidence: Mock success response with auditSaved=true showed the draft RFQ and internal chatter audit confirmation.

limitations: The network mock intercepted the API before it could write to Odoo; this does not prove a real message_post succeeds.
A live test requires a shop-approved supplier and must leave the created RFQ in draft.
